03 / OPEN METHODOLOGY

How the living review works

An automated discovery process with transparent provenance and human oversight.

Read the original review
01

Discover

Search OpenAlex for recently published research, including broad hazard-specific queries that don't require the words “AI” or “machine learning”.

OpenAlex API
02

Screen & classify

Apply a conservative relevance screen and map candidate papers to the domain, application, data type and AI method taxonomy.

Rules + optional LLM
03

Review

Flag uncertain records and allow a human to verify, correct or exclude papers. Automated candidates are never described as fully reviewed evidence.

Expert oversight
04

Publish updates

Generate a versioned, searchable dataset and descriptive charts. The weekly workflow can run automatically once connected to GitHub.

Static web + scheduled job
Important distinction

This is a living evidence map prototype, not a continuously validated systematic review. Title/abstract screening is imperfect; full-text assessment, search validation, inter-rater checks and versioned inclusion criteria would be needed before making systematic-review claims.

Scientific foundation

Reviewer workspace LOCAL

Make human screening decisions, then export them for the update pipeline. Your changes stay in this browser until you export them.
